src/css/styles.css.description: Main CSS file uses a design token system with CSS custom properties. Organized in numbered sections (1-11 currently). Uses BEM-like naming. Responsive breakpoints: mobile (max-width: 767px), tablet (768px-1023px), desktop (1024px+). Container pattern at lines 189-196 should be followed for new containers.

src/_includes/footer.njk.description: Footer component with classes: site-footer, footer-container, footer-content, footer-contact, footer-info, footer-bottom, footer-nav. Contains h3 "Kontakt" heading, contact paragraphs (.contact-name, .contact-location, .contact-region), CTA text (.footer-cta), copyright (.copyright), and legal nav links (Impressum, Datenschutz).
